build_xtreme_pos_dataset: build the xtreme_pos dataset builder for a specific language from Universal Dependencies treebanks
create_dataset_info: create dataset metadata with homepage pointing to Universal Dependencies
generate_examples_per_split: generate examples for train, dev, and test splits from CONLL-U files
download_and_extract_data: download and extract the UD treebanks v2.5 archive from LINDAT repository
process_xtreme_pos_example: process CONLL-U lines into xtreme_pos example dictionaries with POS features
